cohort: Low-risk women with singleton, non-anomalous term pregnancies
finding: While there were no differences in composite adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes between Hispanic and non-Hispanic obese women, newborns of non-Hispanic obese women were more likely to be admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit
mod_finding: The route of delivery was not significantly different between Hispanic and non-Hispanic women across BMI classes.
birth_weight: Measured, increased across BMI for both Hispanic and non-Hispanic groups
